event.title: Bank of America Museums on Us
event.description: Bank of America cardholders receive free general admission – during the first full weekend of every month – to cultural institutions across the United States. How to visit: Present your active Bank of America, Merrill or Bank of America Private Bank credit or debit card and valid government issued photo ID (Passport booklet, State ID, Driver License) to receive one free general admission to either museum location. Please review eligibility and terms prior to your visit: Museums on Us is available to Bank of America, Merrill, or Bank of America Private Bank credit and debit cardholders during the first full weekend of every month. The offer is valid for one general admission only per eligible cardholder. Any special exhibitions, ticketed exhibitions, enhanced experiences, or additional offerings are not included and must be purchased separately. This offer is limited to the individual cardholder, is not transferable, does not guarantee admission, and cannot be combined with other offers. Fundraising events are excluded.
